final_response: Replied to the customer and apologized for the disruption.

args.body:
Subject: Re: Escalation: login failures

Hi,

I’m sorry for the disruption and the login issues your account team is experiencing. We understand this is blocking customer work, and we’re treating it as a priority.

We’re investigating now and will follow up as soon as we have an update. If you can share any error messages or the affected users, that would help us speed things up.

Best,
Support
